Before you book

Short answers to the questions we hear most.

How do I book a ride?

Send us your destination, date and group size on WhatsApp or by phone. We confirm your ride quickly and can plan custom routes. Our team is available 24 hours.

What is the cancellation policy?

Standard bookings can be cancelled up to 48 hours before the trip for a full refund. Custom packages have a longer 7-day window.

How many people can travel?

Our service is for up to 2 travelers. The price is the same whether 1 or 2 people travel.

Book your ride

Message us your pickup point, destination and travel date. We reply within minutes.
